_about: Optional skill families: when a message hits two or more `triggers` (or the session's scope is in `scopes`), the listed `skills` (short names of YOUR installed skills) get a ranking bonus, and `floor` skills are always offered in that scope. Empty by default; add your own, e.g. {"accounting": {"triggers": ["invoice", "ledger", "vat"], "scopes": [], "skills": ["xlsx", "invoice-checker"], "floor": []}}.
